privileged_info_summary: This task requires an AI agent to create a synthetic ActivInspire flipchart document with no external data sources. The agent must create a 2-page flipchart saved to /home/ga/Documents/Flipcharts/coordinate_plane.flipchart containing: Page 1 with title 'Plotting Ordered Pairs' and text including 'coordinate plane'; Page 2 with a coordinate plane diagram showing x and y axes labeled as 'x' and 'y', four quadrants labeled with Roman numerals I through IV, and five plotted points at coordinates (3,4), (-2,5), (-4,-3), (5,-2), and (0,0). The file must contain at least 7 drawing elements (shapes/lines). All metadata claims are consistent with the task description and verification logic.
